<style>
  textarea {
    box-shadow: none !important;
    transition: none !important;
  }

  input {
    box-shadow: none !important;
    transition: none !important;
  }


  #tags-container {
    position: relative;
    display: flex;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 6px;
    padding: 6px 0;
  }

  .tag-chip {
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 4px;
    padding: 2px 8px;
    border-radius: 9999px;
    font-size: 14px;
    background-color: #1e293b;
    color: #f8fafc;
    border: 1px solid #1e293b;
    user-select: none;
  }

  .tag-chip .tag-remove {
    font-size: 15px;
    line-height: 1;
    cursor: pointer;
    opacity: 0.7;
    margin-left: 2px;
  }

  .tag-chip .tag-remove:hover {
    opacity: 1;
  }

  .tag-input-wrapper {
    position: relative;
    display: inline-flex;
    flex: 1;
    min-width: 120px;
  }

  .tag-search-input {
    border: none;
    outline: none;
    font-size: 14px;
    color: #334155;
    background: transparent;
    width: 100%;
  }


  .tag-dropdown {
    position: absolute;
    top: 100%;
    left: 0;
    z-index: 99999;
    background: #ffffff;
    border: 1px solid rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.08);
    border-radius: 10px;
    box-shadow: 0 8px 24px -4px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.15);
    max-height: 220px;
    overflow-y: auto;
    padding: 4px;
    display: none;
  }

  .tag-dropdown.is-open {
    display: block;
  }

  .tag-option {
    padding: 6px;
    border-radius: 6px;
    font-size: 14px;
    color: #334155;
    cursor: pointer;
  }

  .tag-option:hover {
    background-color: #f1f5f9;
  }

  .tag-option.no-results {
    color: #94a3b8;
    cursor: default;
  }

  .tag-option.no-results:hover {
    background: none;
  }


  #editor-toolbar {
    display: inline-flex;
    padding: 4px;
    margin-bottom: 16px;
    color: #334155;
    position: sticky;
    top: var(--navbar-height, 56px);
    z-index: 100;
    background-color: #ffffff;
    width: 100%;
    box-sizing: border-box;
  }

  #editor-toolbar .tb-group {
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 6px;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
  }

  #editor-toolbar .tb-btn {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    border-radius: 4px;
    padding: 4px;
    color: #334155;
    transition: background-color 150ms ease, color 150ms ease;
    background-color: transparent;
    border: none;
    cursor: pointer;
    font-size: 14px;
  }

  #editor-toolbar .tb-btn:hover {
    background-color: #f1f5f9;
  }

  #editor-toolbar .tb-btn.is-active {
    background-color: #e2e8f0;
  }

  #editor-toolbar .tb-icon {
    height: 16px;
    width: 16px;
  }

  #editor-toolbar .tb-text {
    display: inline-block;
    height: 16px;
    min-width: 16px;
    font-size: 14px;
    line-height: 16px;
    font-weight: 600;
    text-align: center;
    font-family: inherit;
  }

  #editor-toolbar .tb-separator {
    height: 16px;
    width: 1px;
    background-color: #e2e8f0;
    margin: 0 2px;
  }

  #editor-toolbar .tb-dropdown-container {
    position: relative;
    display: inline-block;
  }

  #editor-toolbar .tb-dropdown-menu {
    position: absolute;
    top: 100%;
    left: 0;
    z-index: 10;
    background-color: #ffffff;
    border: 1px solid rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05);
    border-radius: 12px;
    box-shadow: 0 25px 50px -12px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.25);
    padding: 6px;
    margin-top: 8px;
    display: none;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 2px;
  }

  #editor-toolbar .tb-dropdown-menu:focus {
    outline: none;
  }

  #editor-toolbar .tb-dropdown-menu.is-open {
    display: flex;
  }

  #editor-toolbar .tb-menu-item {
    width: 100%;
    min-width: max-content;
    justify-content: flex-start;
  }

  #editor img[data-loading="true"],
  #editor video[data-loading="true"] {
    opacity: 0.5;
    animation: upload-pulse 2s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.6, 1) infinite;
  }

  @keyframes upload-pulse {

    0%,
    100% {
      opacity: 0.5;
    }

    50% {
      opacity: 0.85;
    }
  }

  #editor video {
    max-width: 100%;
    border-radius: 4px;
  }

  #editor video[data-error] {
    border: 2px solid #ef4444;
    cursor: pointer;
  }


  .prose {
    color: var(--ink-gray-7);
    line-height: 1.75;
    font-size: 14px;
  }

  .prose h1 {
    color: #111827;
    font-weight: 800;
    font-size: 2.25em;
    margin-top: 0;
    margin-bottom: 0.8888889em;
    line-height: 1.1111111;
  }

  .prose h2 {
    color: #111827;
    font-weight: 700;
    font-size: 1.5em;
    margin-top: 2em;
    margin-bottom: 1em;
    line-height: 1.3333333;
  }

  .prose h3 {
    color: #111827;
    font-weight: 600;
    font-size: 1.25em;
    margin-top: 1.6em;
    margin-bottom: 0.6em;
    line-height: 1.6;
  }

  .prose h4 {
    color: #111827;
    font-weight: 600;
    margin-top: 1.5em;
    margin-bottom: 0.5em;
    line-height: 1.5;
  }

  .prose blockquote {
    font-weight: 500;
    font-style: italic;
    color: #111827;
    border-left-width: 0.25rem;
    border-left-color: #e5e7eb;
    margin-top: 1.6em;
    margin-bottom: 1.6em;
    padding-left: 1em;
  }

  .prose ul {
    list-style-type: disc;
    margin-top: 1.25em;
    margin-bottom: 1.25em;
    padding-left: 1.625em;
  }

  .prose ol {
    list-style-type: decimal;
    margin-top: 1.25em;
    margin-bottom: 1.25em;
    padding-left: 1.625em;
  }

  .prose li {
    margin-top: 0.5em;
    margin-bottom: 0.5em;
  }

  .prose ul li::marker {
    color: #e2e2e2;
  }

  .prose ol li::marker {
    color: #999;
  }

  .prose li p {
    margin-top: 0.25em;
    margin-bottom: 0.25em;
  }

  .prose a {
    color: #111827;
    text-decoration: underline;
    font-weight: 500;
  }

  .prose strong {
    color: #111827;
    font-weight: 600;
  }

  .prose hr {
    border-color: #e5e7eb;
    border-top-width: 1px;
    margin-top: 3em;
    margin-bottom: 3em;
  }

  .prose table {
    box-sizing: border-box;
    border-style: solid;
    border-width: 0;
    text-indent: 0;
    border-color: inherit;
    border-collapse: collapse;
    width: 100%;
    margin-top: 16px;
    margin-bottom: 16px;
    line-height: 1.7;
    table-layout: fixed;
    min-width: 75px;
  }

  .prose table thead {
    background-color: #fff;
  }

  .prose table tr {
    border-top: 1px solid #e5e7eb;
    border-bottom: 1px solid #e5e7eb;
  }

  .prose table th {
    background-color: var(--surface-gray-2);
  }

  .prose table th,
  .prose table td {
    border-left: 1px solid #e5e7eb;
    border-right: 1px solid #e5e7eb;
    padding: 0.5rem;
    vertical-align: top;
    text-align: start;
  }

  .prose ul[data-type="taskList"] {
    padding: 0;
    list-style: none;
  }

  .prose ul[data-type="taskList"] li {
    align-items: flex-start;
    margin: 0;
    display: flex;
  }

  .prose ul[data-type="taskList"] li>label {
    -webkit-user-select: none;
    user-select: none;
    flex: none;
    align-items: center;
    height: 1lh;
    margin-top: 0.25rem;
    margin-right: 0.5rem;
    display: flex;
  }

  .prose ul[data-type="taskList"] li>div {
    flex: auto;
    margin-bottom: 0;
  }

  .prose ul[data-type="taskList"] input[type="checkbox"] {
    cursor: pointer;
    color: #171717;
    border-radius: 4px;
    width: 14px;
    height: 14px;
  }

  .prose code {
    display: block;
    width: 100%;
    color: #24292e;
    border: 1px solid var(--outline-gray-2);
    caret-color: #24292e;
    background: #f6f8fa;
    border-radius: 8px;
    padding: .45rem .75rem;
    font-family: ui-monospace, Menlo, Monaco, Cascadia Mono, Segoe UI Mono, Roboto Mono, Oxygen Mono, Ubuntu Mono, Source Code Pro, Fira Mono, Droid Sans Mono, Consolas, Courier New, monospace;
    font-size: 12px;
    line-height: 1.7;
  }
</style>
